svg.text: Official Rio Grande Games Board Layout, Resource Market & Initial Card Market
3 contiguous regions active (3p) or 4 regions (4p); unused regions closed
Holds up to 2× listed fuel capacity
Turn Order Rules, Auction Loop, Reverse Buying/Building & Step 2/3 Triggers
1. Most connected cities goes 1st (tie: highest plant #).
2. Update Player Order Track before auctioning.
* Round 1 Special Rule: Determine order AFTER Phase 2!
• Max 3 Plants/Player: If buying a 4th plant, immediately scrap 1 owned plant (move compatible fuel).
• No-Sale Rule: If nobody buys ANY plant in Phase 2, discard the lowest plant from Current Market.
• Buy Coal, Oil, Garbage, or Uranium from cheapest available slots on the board.
• Storage Cap: Each plant holds up to 2× its fuel cost (Hybrids hold Coal and/or Oil).
• Reverse Order Advantage: Trailing players buy cheaper fuel before leaders drive prices up.
• Remember: Only buy fuel your owned plants can actually power and store.
• 1st city: Pay 10 Elektro (any open city). Later cities: Cheapest path cost + slot cost (10/15/20).
• Obsolete Plants: Immediately discard any market plant with # ≤ any player's city count.
STEP 2 TRIGGER: When any player connects their 7th city, Step 2 starts at end of Phase 4
(cities now open 2nd house slot for 15 Elektro; increase resource resupply rates).
1. Power Cities & Earn Elektro: Spend fuel to power cities; collect cash from payout chart
2. Resupply Resources: Refill market from right to left using Step 1 / 2 / 3 player-count table.
3. Cycle Market: Move highest Future Market plant to bottom of shuffled deck & draw replacement.
* If Step 3 card drawn: Remove lowest plant & Step 3 card, SHUFFLE remaining deck + discard,
and switch to a single 6-card market (3 house slots per city open for 20 Elektro).
Target city count reached (e.g., 17 for 3–4p)? Finish Phase 5:
Winner = Most POWERED cities (Tie: Most Elektro → Most cities).
